This reduces structural clarity but does not necessarily indicate AI generation; it resembles a poor-quality macro photo.

The transition between the chiton's girdle and the surrounding rock/algae is somewhat muddy. The texture of the girdle lacks the crisp definition of individual spines or scales seen in high-res real photos, appearing slightly 'smudged' or painterly.

The boundaries between the individual shell plates are soft and lack sharp geometric definition. In a real photo, even a blurry one, the hard edges of calcareous plates usually create higher contrast lines than seen here.
